svg.title: Counting transfer results
svg.desc: Accuracy and mean average deviation for five models, including MMaDA, before and after cross-task training. Deltas are relative to baseline. MMaDA accuracies are rounded to whole percentages; accuracy gains use the rounded values.
svg.metadata: {"rounding": "Nearest whole percentage, half up; displayed with one decimal.
